defects.defect: Creates two new roll-ups (Eligible_Review_Score__c, Eligible_Review_Count__c) and leaves Total_Score__c/Total_Reviews__c unfiltered, when the expected change was to add a Status filter to the two existing roll-ups. The stated reason (the layout and Get_Partner_Quality_Watchlist read Total_Reviews__c) is real (verified: the flow references Total_Reviews__c 5 times), but this leaves two parallel count concepts on Storefront__c and makes the watchlist's minReviews count Submitted reviews while its score excludes them (the spec notes this itself as Open item 4).
defects.skill_gap: None explicit. SKILL.md has no rule preferring an in-place change to an existing component over adding parallel fields when the readers would still read the changed meaning correctly.

defects.defect: The single scope question bundled a real intent question (all 92 reviews have blank Status__c, so 'only Published' and 'not Submitted' give different results) with two implementation questions that had clear defaults (which average to change; filter the roll-ups in place or add new ones). The implementation questions should have been decided and recorded as assumptions.
defects.skill_gap: SKILL.md step 5 does not say to leave out implementation-choice questions that have a default when a question has to be asked anyway.

defects.defect: Adds an Apex change and a new test class for AgentSummarizeReviewsActions.averageRating. The requirement is about 'the average rating' (the storefront field); applying the rule to the agent action goes beyond the expected scope, although it is disclosed and justified.
defects.skill_gap: None; the 'one honest scope' guidance exists, and the run treated this as within scope based on the user's 'no preference' answer.
